scope: equipment traits, battle line, enemy target rules, hazards, weapon classes

checks.name: Liyue companions can hold their official weapon class
traits add up from worn gear and the weapon class, with caps and readable lines
battle line order is saved, validated and decides positions and slot bonuses
leaving and joining members keep the line consistent
enemy target rules weigh the front row, back row, lead, tail and snipers; gear adds aggro or stealth
the weighted pick favours the front row against a melee enemy
an adjacent ally with a shield or cover gear takes single-target hits, never area ones
hazards hurt the chosen rows each round end, shields absorb them and matching gear mitigates
offensive traits: slayer, aura hunter, anti-air, armour break, weak point, element boost, first strike
defensive traits: element resistance, heavy armour, first guard, stagger and control resistance, heal and shield boosts
on-hit traits: stacking attack, extra physical hits, kill heal and high-HP crit
the Isekai protagonist reaches as far as the weapon class; the Traveler stays a swordsman
air access gear lets melee strike airborne enemies
UI wiring: gear traits, battle line editor, hazard panel (source)
